problem: BeBee has a validated deterministic visual-QA design but no production runtime state router, readiness bridge, exact-head desktop/mobile capture path, repeatability proof or release guard. Later player-facing agents therefore cannot yet bind rendered evidence to a known Defold state and exact source candidate.

decision.rationale: Implement the already-validated BB-P008 contract: a development-only Defold QA router publishes explicit state/seed/readiness/exact-SHA provenance through window.__bebeeQA, while pinned Playwright uses clean BrowserContexts to capture canonical desktop/mobile evidence twice and the release build is adversarially checked for bridge/query absence.

research.candidate_pool_exception: Shipped-product research is not applicable to deterministic CI/browser evidence infrastructure; the behavior is constrained by the already-validated repository QA contract and current Defold/Playwright APIs.
research.reference_exception: BB-006 makes no new player-facing visual/aesthetic decision and does not claim that the placeholder movement fixture satisfies P1 visual assertions.

anti_pattern.observation: Browser capture synchronized by arbitrary sleeps is weaker than an explicit JavaScript testing bridge because it cannot prove the game state/readiness represented by a screenshot.
anti_pattern.lesson: Make engineReady/captureReady authoritative and fail closed on unknown states or provenance mismatch instead of sleeping and capturing whatever happens to be on screen.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Defold HTML5 can be browser-automated for runtime screenshots and JavaScript/console error checks, and an explicit JavaScript testing bridge is an appropriate synchronization boundary.
html5.run executes JavaScript from the Defold HTML5 runtime, allowing the development-only engine state router to publish the readiness/provenance bridge.
Custom project settings can be declared in game.properties and read through sys.get_config_* so QA enablement and source provenance can be build-configured rather than hard-coded.
Bob supports repeated --settings arguments applied left to right, so an ephemeral exact-head provenance settings file can override the tracked mode settings without modifying source files.
Playwright BrowserContext provides isolated clean-slate browser sessions appropriate for independent order-insensitive QA captures.
The selected Playwright Python package is an Apache-2.0 browser automation QA dependency and is not required in the BeBee runtime bundle.

alternatives.reason: Directly implements BB-P008, provides clean BrowserContext isolation and maintained screenshot/error APIs, and keeps state readiness authoritative in the Defold runtime.

The BB-005 raw-CDP client is intentionally narrow; extending it would make BeBee maintain context isolation, capture and page-error plumbing that Playwright already provides and BB-P008 already selected.
A fixed delay cannot prove state identity, seed, exact build provenance or deterministic readiness and can conceal async races.
Shipping the QA bridge/router would violate the validated release contract and add an unnecessary production debug surface.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Development HTML5 can select a known QA state and fixed seed through the canonical query parameters and reports authoritative bridge readiness/provenance.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: app/qa_router.lua implements movement_empty, default/fixed seed handling, exact build SHA, engineReady/captureReady and fail-closed unknown-state behavior; exact-head browser CI must prove it.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The same known state is captured on canonical desktop and mobile-landscape viewports and repeated isolated captures are byte-stable.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tools/visual_qa/capture.py captures desktop_reference and mobile_landscape twice in fresh BrowserContexts and requires identical PNG SHA-256 plus simulationFrame.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Capture evidence includes exact-head, bundle, Defold, browser, state, seed, viewport, simulation-frame and capture hash provenance plus console/page error counts.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The Playwright runner writes the canonical fields into artifacts/visual-qa/<head>/capture-report.json and retains console.log; exact-head artifact CI must prove the files.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Release does not expose the QA bridge and QA query parameters do not activate QA behavior.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: release.settings explicitly sets bebee.qa_enabled=0; the capture runner probes plain and QA-query release contexts, requires no bridge and requires identical release screenshot hashes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Candidate runtime execution remains read-only and outside trusted-base governance authority while visual evidence becomes a retained exact-head artifact.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: BB-006 extends the existing contents:read pull_request/push HTML5 CI workflow. The trusted pull_request_target evidence workflow and policy implementation are not modified.

automated: Repository standards, Test and data, HTML5 CI and trusted-base PR evidence validation must all pass on the final exact PR head.
HTML5 CI must retain a visual-qa-<head_sha> artifact containing capture-report.json, console.log and desktop/mobile movement_empty PNGs.
The runner itself adversarially checks unknown/mismatched readiness conditions through fail-closed bridge semantics and release QA-parameter/bridge absence.
verification.runtime_errors: No runtime success is claimed before exact-head CI. Browser HTTP/request/console/page errors are retained and actionable failures reject the job; Chromium's automatic favicon 404 is the only narrowly classified browser-generated exception.

governance.trust_boundary_change: The existing unprivileged exact-source HTML5 CI workflow gains dependency installation and candidate visual-QA execution/artifact retention. It remains pull_request/push with contents:read. No pull_request_target workflow, ruleset, secrets permission or trusted evidence policy code changes.
governance.bypass_analysis: The candidate can modify its own HTML5/visual-QA workflow and tooling, so these outputs are technical regression/evidence signals rather than governance authority. The unchanged trusted-base validate-pr-evidence workflow independently classifies the diff and validates the manifest. Release behavior is checked from the separately built release bundle rather than trusting a development flag assertion alone.
governance.rollback: Revert the BB-006 workflow additions, QA router/build settings, Playwright/local-serve/capture tooling and dependency ledger entries. The BB-005 playable HTML5 CI, BB-003 input/proxy smoke and BB-004 test/data workflow remain independently usable.

known_limitations: movement_empty is a technical bootstrap fixture at P0 and is not evidence that P1 movement composition or the eventual bee-visible assertion is complete.
Only the minimum one-state desktop/mobile still-capture foundation is implemented in BB-006; the other canonical states and motion clips are implemented by the milestones that own those systems.
No universal screenshot pixel-diff tolerance or golden-image regression policy is introduced; repeated unchanged capture uses exact SHA equality to prove the current deterministic fixture only.
